description: A value a context slot feeds a field decodes against the field's own type, as an explicit supply does: the String-typed shelf slot set by defaults feeds Book.shelf (optional<ShelfRef>) a reference in the shelves domain decoded through its codec, feeds Book.tags (list<ShelfRef>) a one-element list holding that reference, and feeds Book.placed (a PlacedRef whose qualification may come from context) a reference carrying the namespace slot's value attic as its context, so it links to the spot attic declares; an explicit shelf property still wins over the slot, and the reading links clean under complete scope
